notes.title: Akupara Games is Publishing Echo Weaver!
notes.content:
Hey Weavers,

My name is Joseph, and I’m the community manager for Akupara Games and I’m excited to reveal that we’ve partnered with Moonlight Kids to bring Echo Weaver to our tortoise family of games!

The moment I beat the demo, I knew that Echo Weaver was something special which many people from the team, including me, have been itching to tell you more about! We could see the quality and passion that Moonlight Kids put into Echo Weaver and that was something we’re eager to support. 

[previewyoutube=7GbbVO23e3g;full][/previewyoutube]

Echo Weaver is a time loop metroidBRAINia where time is your currency and secrets are your only upgrades. You are the last Weaver, remnant of a ruined society trapped in a fatal time loop. Uncover their story - and your own - as you explore what remains.

Wishlist Echo Weaver
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184080/Echo_Weaver/

I can’t wait to share more information about Echo Weaver but the first door closes in ten seconds and we have no time to stand around; Get going! 

- Riv otter
